$comment: Frontier step 0. Structure only; non-emptiness and the 1-3 sentence rule are checked by tools/check.py ([INTAKE]); vp.none_reason by [VP-MODE].

idea.description: The research idea in 1 to 3 sentences.

language.description: Language of the user (code such as en, fr): the free text of the JSON files, hence the prose of IDEA-CARD.md, is written in it.

text.description: What new knowledge or capability would justify the effort.

source.description: assumption = the user was not there to answer.

project_dirs.description: Optional. LOCAL paths of the user's own project archives, given by the user (step 0-bis, tools/history.py). Absent or empty: the step is marked not checked. Their content stays on this machine.

context.description: Optional (step 0-quater). The project's goal, data, constraints and key numbers. Key numbers are used by tools/sim.py (--context) only when confirmed; extracted ones carry the file:line they were read at.

cited.description: file:line inside a project folder (extracted numbers).

runs.description: name -> path of a VP working directory (relative to this directory or absolute).

none_reason.description: Why VP is not used although it is installed (required then).
